activity_screen.rule_ar: يجب ألا ينص النظام الأساسي للشركة على أهداف تتضمن التعامل الربوي أو الاتجار في الخمور أو منتجات الخنزير وما شابه، وأن يكون نشاطها الأساسي مباحًا.
activity_screen.rule_en: The company's articles of association must not state objectives involving riba dealing, alcohol or pork trading or similar prohibitions, and its main activity must be permissible. Conventional banks and non-bank financial companies are excluded by this screen in the index methodology (Islamic banks under a Sharia board are admitted).

basis: Joining conditions of the EGX 33 Shariah Index as quoted by the Sharia Supervisory Committee's vice-chair (Dr. Ezz El-Din Tohamy, 2025-02-19) and restated by Thndr Learn, Kashif's Egyptian-standard article and Ostool's compliance report, which adopts these criteria verbatim.

documented_conflicts.detail_ar: ذكرت تغطية الإطلاق في يونيو 2024 حدًّا قدره 10%، بينما تنص المنهجية المنقولة عن نائب رئيس لجنة الرقابة الشرعية وبيان مراجعة البورصة في أغسطس 2025 على 5%. المعتمد هنا 5%، ورقم 10% موثق كهذا التعارض.
documented_conflicts.detail_en: June 2024 launch coverage (Mubasher quoting the EGX chairman; Al-Ahram Weekly; an Arab Exchanges report describing eligibility as 'at least 90% compliant by revenue') reported a 10% limit. The methodology text quoted by the Sharia Committee's vice-chair states 5%, Thndr Learn, Kashif and Ostool all restate 5%, and EGX's August 2025 semi-annual review release names 5% as the binding figure for the income criterion. This rule set encodes 5% as operative and records the 10% figure here as a documented conflict, not a silent choice.

name_ar: منهجية مؤشر الشريعة EGX33 — لجنة الرقابة الشرعية بالبورصة المصرية (مؤسسة على المعيار الشرعي رقم 21 لأيوفي)
name_en: EGX 33 Shariah Index methodology — EGX Sharia Supervisory Committee (grounded in AAOIFI Sharia Standard No. 21)
notes: Index-level rules that are not per-company screens (33 constituents, 15% single-stock weight cap, semi-annual reviews end-January/end-July) are methodology context, not encoded as screening ratios.
Ostool Securities adopts these criteria verbatim, so verdicts under this rule set are the comparison basis for Ostool's published list in the benchmark work of this series.

v1.1.0 (issue #329): borrowing and investments are divided by total assets, per the published EGX33 criteria pinned in the #169 research. The earlier max(total assets, average market value in the review period) base was a misreading and is retired; it flipped ABUK H1-2026 from a 60.12% fail to a 23.28% pass.

capital_component.definition_ar: لا تنشر البورصة المصرية قاعدة تطهير لمؤشر EGX33، فلا يعلن هذا المعيار مكوّنًا رأسماليًا أيضًا.
capital_component.definition_en: EGX publishes no purification rule for EGX33, so this rule set declares no capital component either.

purification.notes_ar: لا تنشر البورصة المصرية قاعدة تطهير خاصة بمؤشر EGX33؛ التطهير متروك للمستثمر. لذلك لا يعرض هذا المعيار نسبة تطهير ولا قيمة تطهير للسهم.
purification.notes_en: EGX publishes no purification rule for EGX33; purification is left to the investor. This rule set therefore reports no purification ratio and no per-share purification figure.

ratios.label_ar: الدخل من أنشطة غير متوافقة / إجمالي الإيرادات
ratios.label_en: Income from non-compliant activities / total revenue
